capabilities: customize which commands appear in the slash menu
define custom trigger characters, including additional and per-command triggers
restrict triggering to the beginning of a line or new line
reorder command list items via drag-and-drop
extras: Usage sections are headings without visible content; the release section (version bump workflow) targets plugin developers. Credits also name Periodic Notes, Admonitions, Highlightr, and Typing Assistant as sources for the standalone menu suggest.
intentEvidence: Customizable slash command list for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in slash command menu is fixed, so users cannot control which commands appear or when and how the menu is triggered.

relations.evidence: UI design & data structures: based on Commander

summary: Customizable slash command menu that lets users pick which commands appear, reorder them, assign icons, and define custom trigger characters.
